findings.summary: In _parse_data, when no boundary is found, data_end/del_index from last_newline() can be smaller than data_start, so DATA_START doesn't consume the leading CRLF and it leaks into the field data when the body arrives in chunks, corrupting the value.

DATA_START always emits a Data event without the 'if data or not more_data' guard, producing spurious empty Data(b'', more_data=True) events for partial chunks that consumers like MultipartEncoder and the form parser may not expect.
cast(Match[bytes], match).end() hides a possible None from LINE_BREAK_RE.match, which would raise AttributeError instead of a clear error; an explicit check is safer.
The new test test_empty_field feeds the whole body in one receive_data call and so doesn't cover the chunked-input leading CRLF bug; a test splitting mid-field is needed.
